prompt: What is the name of the steel roller coaster that most recently lost its title as the tallest operating steel roller coaster in the world?
answer: **Kingda Ka** most recently held the title of tallest operating steel roller coaster before it was surpassed by **Falcon’s Flight** at Six Flags Qiddiya City.
